review_method: Codex comparison of actual answers with frozen source excerpts and table relationships; conservative completeness gate

group_reviews.finding: 2026 median income values match requested households 1 through 7 and source won units.
Each value matches the requested household and benefit selection row. Answers explicitly distinguish income eligibility thresholds from actual payments.
Emergency livelihood amounts match requested households 2, 3, 5 and 6 with explicit monthly units.

301,000 won increment and the retained household amounts match the source. Three other claims were removed by grounding validation, leaving an explicit partial-answer warning; counted as incomplete, not a completed correct answer.
Benefit-to-rate relationships are livelihood 32%, medical 40%, housing 48%, education 50%; values are stated as income selection thresholds.
Single/couple pension income eligibility limits are 2,470,000/3,952,000 won, not monthly pension payment amounts.
Parent cash allowance for a child not using daycare is age 0: 1,000,000 won/month and age 1: 500,000 won/month; no retrospective or daycare balance amounts are substituted.
First/second birth voucher amounts are 2,000,000/3,000,000 won; first-birth amount is not described as an ambiguous lower bound.

limitations: These 50 questions were used during error diagnosis and tuning, so this is regression verification.
Household values from a few source tables are correlated and do not represent all welfare tasks.
Answers combine source-bound deterministic lookups and local E2B generation.
The review is by Codex, not an independent welfare practitioner.
